title: Tidewater 2112-Gulf Front-Heated Pool-Hot Tub
description:
Top Reasons to Book this Gulf-Front Condo!

The space
* Floor-to-Ceiling Beach FRONT Views!

* Two Gulf-side Pools, Hot Tubs, Indoor Heated Pool

* Tiki Bar, Sauna, Steam Room, Fitness Center

* Grilling Area, Game Room, and MORE!

* Under 1 Mile from Pier Park

* Professionally Managed; 24/7 service

*This property is not available to adults under age 25. No Exceptions. *

* Guests are required to pay a fee for parking passes and wristbands at Tidewater. Pay Early Registration $39.59 when you pre-register more than 24 hours before your stay. 24 Hours or Less = Late Registration $50.29. You may pay your fee upon arrival; however, you will pay the late registration price.*

Welcome to Tidewater 2112, a beautifully appointed 1-bedroom, 2-bath Gulf-front condo offering the perfect setting for your next beach getaway. Decorated in soothing coastal neutrals, this inviting retreat features breathtaking views of the emerald waters from its private furnished balcony. The open living area provides a comfortable space to relax after a day at the beach, while the fully equipped kitchen features stone countertops, a dishwasher, and everything needed to prepare meals during your stay. For added convenience, the condo includes a private washer and dryer, making it easy to pack light. Guests can also enjoy a DVD player and a collection of DVDs for cozy movie nights. The spacious master bedroom offers a king-size bed, a private en-suite bathroom, and direct balcony access where you can wake up to stunning Gulf views. Additional sleeping accommodations include a cozy bunk nook with twin bunk beds, along with a sleeper sofa in the living room, allowing the condo to comfortably sleep up to 6 guests. When you're ready to venture beyond the condo, Tidewater's resort amenities include indoor and outdoor pools, hot tubs, a fitness center, charcoal grilling areas, and direct beach access, ensuring fun and relaxation for the entire family.

Tidewater Beach Resort opened in March 2008. It’s a luxury resort ideally located on a large expanse of sugar-white sandy beaches along the Gulf of Mexico and convenient to area dining, shopping and activities. It has plenty of amenities designed to please. Make a splash in one of the large beachfront pools, enjoy a refreshing beverage at the poolside tiki bar, or just relax with a peaceful stroll along the beach. There’s also an indoor heated pool, hot tubs, sauna, steam room, fitness center, and MORE! Under a mile to Pier Park, Tidewater Beach Resort is a fantastic destination for your next beach vacation!

The Bed Setup:

Master Bedroom: King Bed

Bunk Nook: Twin Bunk Bed

Living Room: Sleeper Sofa

* During busy seasons, the property experiences increased guest traffic, which may result in longer-than-normal elevator wait times. We appreciate your understanding and recommend allowing a few extra minutes when planning your arrivals and departures. *

*Please note the parking garage at Tidewater has a maximum height restriction of 7 feet. *

Area Attractions:  

Adventurous guests might like to try kayaking, parasailing, jet skiing, diving and snorkeling excursions, all available nearby!

If you're looking for great shopping and fabulous eateries, nearby Pier Park will fit the bill! With more than 125 retail, dining, and entertainment choices, Pier Park is a one-of-a-kind beachfront family-friendly attraction featuring island-inspired architecture and popular stores. Dillard’s, JCPenney, Ron Jon Surf Shop, Target, and Forever 21 are but a few. Dine at numerous eateries like Jimmy Buffett’s Margaritaville, Dick’s Last Resort, and Five Guys Burgers or catch a show at the Grand IMAX Theater.

Registration Number=74106

Other things to note
Real Joy does not rent to groups of guests under 25 years through AirBNB. Adults under 25 years of age must be accompanied by a parent. This House Rule overrides all information you may see on the ad of the property. Breaking this rule will lead to cancellation and/or eviction.

CHECK IN IS AT 4PM. No exceptions at this time.

title: Coastal Calm 412-Gulf Views-Sleeps 6
description:
Welcome to Coastal Calm, your serene beachfront escape at Tidewater Beach Resort. Located on the low 4th floor, this Gulf-front condo offers sweeping ocean views from a spacious 150 sq. ft. private balcony, accessible from both the living room and master bedroom. This popular “Type L” floorplan features 1 bedroom, 2 bathrooms, and a separate bunk nook, creating the comfort and functionality of a two-bedroom unit.

Other things to note
Primary renter must be at least 25 years of age. Guests may be asked to present their IDs upon arrival or anytime during their stay. Do not rent this unit for another party. The primary renter must be staying in the unit.

About the Vacation Rental Unit:

Coastal Calm is located just 2 floors above the walkway, making it super convenient for guests who like to avoid using the elevator during high demand periods. Tastefully updated and decorated in a light coastal style, Coastal Calm is fully equipped for short or extended stays. Updates include a 75" Smart TV in the living room, a 65" Smart TV in the master bedroom, two plush recliners, and refreshed furnishings for a bright, relaxing vibe. The master bathroom was also updated to include a walk-in shower.

This 1-bedroom, 2-bathroom vacation rental features:
Master Bedroom: King bed with a plush, high-quality mattress for added comfort, Gulf views, direct balcony access, and a 65" Smart TV
Common Area Sleeping Arrangements: Twin-over-twin bunk nook in the hallway and Queen sofa sleeper in the living room
Ensuite Master Bathroom: Recently upgraded with a spacious walk-in shower
Guest Bathroom: With a shower/tub combo
Maximum Guest Occupancy: 6 Guests (Please note that children under the age of two years still count toward the maximum guest occupancy.)

The fully equipped kitchen includes granite countertops, a side-by-side refrigerator, flat-top stove, oven, microwave, dishwasher, and all cookware, utensils, and tools needed to prepare meals. A washer and dryer are located in-unit for your convenience. Please note: beach chairs are not included with this rental.

About the Community/Property:

Welcome to Tidewater Beach Resort, offering breathtaking views of the Gulf of Mexico and a prime location just 15 minutes from ECP Airport. Guests are within walking distance of Pier Park, which features more than 100 shops, restaurants, and attractions, including Dolly Parton’s Pirates Voyage Dinner and Show. Tidewater is also one of the few resorts in the area with onsite security, adding an extra level of convenience and peace of mind for guests during their stay.

Tidewater Resort offers top-of-the-line onsite amenities, including two outdoor pools overlooking the Gulf, one heated indoor pool, two spa whirlpools, a fitness center, steam room, and sauna. The resort also features 7 elevators, which helps make access throughout the property more convenient. Frank Brown Park is just a short distance away with more than 200 acres of sports fields, playgrounds, and walking trails.

Parking:

All guests must pre-register with the resort! Sooner is better since there are additional fees (and long lines) associated with registering late. Preregistering means wristbands are programmed, and parking passes are created ahead of your arrival. Guests must stop by the Tidewater registration desk upon arrival to pick up wristbands and parking pass. You’ll find this registration desk just inside the walkway doors, on the second floor.

The parking garage is located across the street from Tidewater Resort. Since it changes periodically, the parking garage gate code will be sent in your Safe Travels email. Guests may purchase two parking permits for a 1- or 2-bedroom unit and 3 parking permits for a 3-bedroom unit. Cost for such passes is listed below.

Parking spaces in the garage aren't assigned, so legally park where you are able to. Locate the skybridge on level 2; this will take you across the street to the main complex. After crossing the skybridge, go to the Tidewater registration desk, located right inside the doors from the crosswalk. This is where you will pick up your parking passes as well as your amenity wristbands. Return to your car(s) and place the permit(s) as directed.

Parking restrictions: No vehicle exceeding 7 feet, 2 inches in height is allowed in the garage. For the safety of all, pickups with extended beds or cabs, dual wheels, tow bars, and extended rear luggage carriers are only permitted to park in the north side, rear end of the garage. Roof luggage carriers must be removed before entering the garage. Rental golf carts, scooters, and bubble cars are not authorized to park in the garage or porte-cochere. Those in violation of these rules are subject to tow at the owner’s/renter’s expense.

Helpful Tip About Elevators at Tidewater: Like all high-rise buildings, Tidewater can experience longer elevator wait times during peak hours—especially around check-in (4-5pm) and check-out (10-11am). This is largely due to the use of luggage and grocery-style carts, which take up significant space and limit the number of passengers per ride. Many guests find it helpful to avoid using the elevators during these busy times when possible. A little planning can make arrival and departure much smoother!

Loading and Cart Info
• There are 30-minute loading/unloading spaces available on the second floor of the parking garage near the skywalk. Feel free to use one while moving your belongings in or out of the condo.
• Luggage carts and grocery-style carts are available to help carry items. Note that luggage carts do not fit inside the condos, but you can leave them just outside your door while unloading.
• Please return carts promptly after use so they’re available for other guests.

Amenity Wristbands: Guests registering at Tidewater must be over 25 years old and registration should occur at least 24 hours in advance of arrival (ideally, more than 24 hours prior). Amenity wristbands are allocated to guests at the Tidewater registration desk, located on the 2nd floor of the resort. Wristbands will be given to guests ages 12 and up at check-in. Guests are required to wear these wristbands while on the property. Fees for these wristbands vary, depending upon when you register. This fee includes the aforementioned parking permits.

Wristband Return Reminder: At check-out, please return all wristbands to the same reservation desk where you picked them up. You’ll find the return box at the reservation desk on the 2nd floor of the resort. Thanks for helping us keep things running smoothly!

PREREGISTRATION FEES (pre-registration must occur more than 24 hours in advance of arrival): about $40 + tax for a 1-bedroom unit, about $55 + tax for a 2-bedroom unit and about $70 + tax for a 3-bedroom unit.

LATE REGISTRATION FEES: about $50 + tax for a 1-bedroom unit, about $65 + tax for a 2-bedroom unit and about $80 + tax for a 3-bedroom unit.

For the security of our guests and the safety of the resort, there are external security cameras located in the garage.

Other details to note:

Proper ID wristbands are required to be worn at all times while on Tidewater Resort property. The replacement fee for each lost or stolen wristband is $25 plus tax.

Trash chutes cannot be stuffed with cardboard boxes or other forms of large debris. Prior to disposal in the chutes, please bag any trash. All large items in need of disposal must be taken off site. Violators who are caught dumping trash inappropriately may be fined by the association and/or reported to local law enforcement.

Upon booking, you’ll receive timely communications about your trip. Access to your professionally cleaned and sanitized home is also convenient with our custom keyless locks. And, if you need anything before, during or after your stay, our local team is ready to help!

Please be aware that there will be NO refunds for Wi-Fi issues as it’s not guaranteed. If reliable Wi-Fi is a must, you are welcome to bring your own internet hotspot.

Non-negotiable rules: No Smoking or Vaping, No Events or Parties, No Firearms. Quiet hours are from 10pm to 7am (unless posted signage indicates otherwise).

reviews.text: David was very quick to respond to any questions that I had. Very friendly.

Other than that, the room was as expected and everything was great. The pools were a major plus. We would gladly stay here again…😃

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We absolutely loved the apartment! The host is a very pleasant person who created wonderful conditions for us. We enjoyed everything—especially the incredible view of the ocean! We highly recommend it!
Dave was great host.  He was very responsive and place was done early so got to check in earlier than expected.  Would definitely stay here again.

Overall it was okay but the front door didn’t stay latched properly, we came back twice to find the door ajar. Keurig didn’t work, washer had problems draining but after trying every setting it only drained when washed on “heavy duty”. When we arrived we were supposed to be able to enter room at 4pm…. Cleaning crew was still there and asked us to wait 2 different times for an extra 10-15 minutes so we didn’t even get to enter room until closer to 4:30. The floors were still dirty, it was dusty and crumbs on counters in kitchen. Beautiful views from the room though. I communicated with David about every issue I had encountered as soon as it happened and he wasn’t the best at trying to help.  He knew the Keurig was broke on day 2 of our week trip and it wasn’t until day 5 when he offered to have a new one along with a broom delivered because I told him there wasn’t one in the unit &he expected us to sit around and wait for 4-5 hours for instacart to deliver it as well. Elevators suck too
reviews.response:
Thank you for your feedback—I truly appreciate you taking the time to share your experience.
I’m very sorry to hear about the issues you encountered during your stay. The front door, appliances, and cleanliness concerns you mentioned are not the standard we aim to provide, and I understand how frustrating that must have been—especially after a long day of travel. I also apologize for the delayed check-in and the inconvenience caused by the cleaning timing.
Regarding communication, I regret that my responses did not meet your expectations. My intention is always to address concerns as quickly and effectively as possible, and it’s clear I could have handled this better in your case. Your feedback about the timing and coordination of replacements (like the coffee maker and broom) is noted, and I will work on improving how these situations are managed so future guests aren’t inconvenienced.
I’m glad you were able to enjoy the beautiful views, but I understand that the other issues impacted your overall experience. Thank you again for bringing these matters to my attention—they are being addressed to ensure improvements moving forward.
Wishing you all the best in your future travels.

I do wish there were some beach items in the unit and or even a little space for us to leave things for other guests, some units do have this.  We bought floats that could have been left for others. We really enjoyed our stay! The condo was spotless, very well stocked, and had a beautiful view. The outdoor pools were warm, and the ocean was even warmer—just perfect. I had a wonderful birthday weekend at this Airbnb! The host was extremely responsive and provided all the details we needed ahead of time. The home looked exactly like the photos, was spotless, and everything went smoothly during our stay. I’d definitely rent from this host again.
